hero.emblemAlt: A golden hand holding a silver eight-pointed star, wrapped in a blue ribbon
hero.eyebrow: Arcana Subclass · XVII · The Star · Aspect of Hope

epigraph.html: We keep a light burning after every fall, and the Weave lets us pour it into the wounded.

hero.ledeHtml: Mystra wove the Starchild from the light that remains after disaster, a thread of hope that never stops shining. They mend wounds that should have been fatal, shelter their allies beneath solar and lunar wards, and call the fallen back from the edge of death. The Starchild is the Arcana's healer. You strike with starlight to fuel your own renewal, pour that light into wounded allies, and raise those who fall. Late in your journey the same light burns, blinds and silences whole groups of enemies.

blocks.html:
The seventeenth card of the Major Arcana shows a figure kneeling at the edge of a pool beneath a night sky. They pour water from two jugs: one into the pool, one onto the dry earth beside it. Above them a great star burns, ringed by seven smaller ones.

The Star follows The Tower, the card of sudden ruin. That is why it reads as hope: the storm has passed, the walls have fallen, and something is still shining. It is the card of healing after the worst has happened, of renewal that asks for nothing back, and of a light that shows the way home.

This is the Starchild's destiny. One jug pours into the wounded; the other waters the ground the party stands on, as wards of sun and moon. The great star is the light itself, gentle on allies and merciless on anyone who tries to put it out.

upright.title: Upright
upright.html: You keep the party standing: heals, wards and revivals that arrive when the fight has turned against you.

reversed.title: Reversed
reversed.html: Enemies meet the other face of the light: Blinded, Silenced, Stunned and set Burning, cut off from the fight.

blocks.html: You are the party's healer and support. A typical turn starts with Starcall on an enemy: it deals Radiant damage, slows the target and grants you Rejuvenation. Your bonus action then goes to Astral Infusion, which heals an ally without costing you any hit points while Rejuvenation lasts. Around that rhythm you place wards (Lunar Aegis, Moon Gravity, Astral Fortitude), cleanse conditions with Solar Purge, and bring the fallen back with Starbreath. From level 5 you also shape the battlefield with light, and at level 11 you gain two of the hardest-hitting area spells in the class.

blocks.title: At a Glance
blocks.html:
• Role: healer and support, with area control late on.
  • Strengths: single-target and group healing, revival, a cleanse for most conditions, Armour Class and hit point wards, medium armour and shields.
  • Weaknesses: modest damage until level 11; five key spells need Concentration; Astral Infusion costs your own hit points without Rejuvenation; the Aspect of Hope only grows when allies get hurt.
  • Tip: cast Lunar Wisp before a fight. It needs no action and stays until combat ends, so every heal in that fight also grants temporary hit points.

rows.label: Hit Points
rows.html: 6 + your Constitution modifier at level 1, then 4 + your Constitution modifier per level

rows.label: Secondary Ability
rows.html: Wisdom (Rejuvenation, Lunar Wisp and the Aspect of Hope scale with it)

rows.label: Weapons
rows.html: Clubs, daggers, javelins, maces, quarterstaffs, sickles, spears

rows.label: Skills
rows.html: Choose 4 from Animal Handling, Arcana, History, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Religion and Survival. Then gain Expertise in 2 of them.

rows.label: Suggested Abilities
rows.html: Strength 8 · Dexterity 10 · Constitution 13 · Intelligence 15 · Wisdom 15 · Charisma 10. At creation, +2 and +1 to two abilities of your choice.

rows.label: Starting Equipment
rows.html: Starchild's Robe, Mace, Shield, 2 Potions of Healing, a Scroll of Revivify, shoes and camp clothes

intro.html: Starchild features only. The Arcana's own features, shared by every destiny, are on the class page.

cells: Starcall, Astral Infusion, Light, Cosmic Omen
Stellar Anchor, 17 - The Star: Awakening (Beacon), Solar Purge, Lunar Aegis, Lunar Wisp
Aspect of Hope, Stellar Grace Feat

blocks.html:
Your two level 1 spells are built to be cast together. Starcall takes your action: a ranged spell attack that deals Radiant damage, reduces the target's movement speed for 1 turn and gives you Rejuvenation for 2 turns. Rejuvenation increases your movement speed by 30% and restores hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier at the end of each turn.

Astral Infusion takes your bonus action and heals an ally within 9m. Normally it also costs you 10% of your maximum hit points, and you can't cast it at all while you are at 11% of your hit points or lower. While you have Rejuvenation, that cost disappears: the heal costs only the Woven Spell Slot.

Every heal you give an ally feeds two other things. With Lunar Wisp active, the healed ally also gains temporary hit points equal to your Arcana level plus twice your Wisdom modifier. From level 3, the hit points you restore to allies in combat count towards the Aspect of Hope.

blocks.title: One Turn, in Order
blocks.html:
• Action: Starcall an enemy. On a hit you gain Rejuvenation.
  • Bonus action: Astral Infusion on the ally who needs it most, with no hit point cost.
  • End of turn: Rejuvenation restores your Wisdom modifier in hit points.

Starcall grants Rejuvenation only when it hits. If it misses, Infusion still works, but it takes its 10% from you.

All your Woven Spell Slots share one level, so every spell is cast with a slot of your current Slot Level and uses that level's values. Starbreath returns a fallen ally with the listed share of their maximum hit points; Wish heals every ally within 18m.

The Starchild's light takes three forms. Solar light purges and burns: it clears conditions from allies and sets enemies alight. Lunar light shelters: it hardens Armour Class, wraps healing in temporary hit points and keeps allies moving. Starlight heals, revives and reveals. The Aspect of Hope follows the same pattern, marking allies as Moonlit, then Sunlit, then shielding them with an Eclipse.

blocks.title: Concentration
blocks.html: Five of your spells need Concentration: Lunar Aegis, Lucent Singularity, Star Radiance, Final Spark and Stellar Grace. You can hold only one at a time, so choose the one that matters most in this fight. Stellar Anchor gives you Advantage on Saving Throws to keep it when you take damage.

intro.html: Every Starchild spell is Always Prepared.

features.name: Starcall
features.bodyHtml:
Hurl a radiant star at a target.

On a hit, deals 1d6 Radiant damage. The target's movement speed is reduced by 30% for 1 turn, and you gain Rejuvenation for 2 turns.

At higher levels: 2d6 with a level 2 slot, 3d6 with a level 3 slot, up to 6d6 with a level 6 slot.

features.name: Astral Infusion
features.bodyHtml:
Transfuse a portion of your own life force through an astral bond.

An ally regains 1d10 hit points. If you don't have Rejuvenation, you also sacrifice 10% of your own maximum hit points. You can't cast it while you are at 11% of your hit points or lower, and it can't target yourself, Undead or Constructs.

At higher levels: 2d10 with a level 2 slot, 3d10 with a level 3 slot, up to 6d10 with a level 6 slot.

features.name: Light
features.bodyHtml: Infuse an object with an aura of light. If you target the weapon a hostile creature is holding, it can resist with a Dexterity Saving Throw.

features.name: Cosmic Omen
features.bodyHtml:
Whenever you Long Rest, you consult the stars for a Cosmic Omen of Weal or of Woe, chosen at random.

  • Weal: as a reaction, add 1d6 to an ally's Attack Roll that would miss or a Saving Throw that would fail. You can also give your allies a +1d6 bonus to Ability Checks.
  • Woe: as a reaction, subtract 1d6 from an enemy's Attack Roll that would hit or from its Saving Throw.

features.name: Stellar Anchor
features.bodyHtml: Your consciousness is anchored to the unchanging positions of the stars. You have Advantage on Saving Throws to maintain Concentration on a spell.

features.name: 17 - The Star: Awakening
features.bodyHtml:
Heal your allies during a fight to awaken the Aspect of Hope until combat ends. Healing beyond an ally's maximum hit points doesn't count. Each goal you reach awakens one more tier.

At level 3 you can reach Tier I, Beacon: restore hit points equal to 5 times your level. Allies you heal or target with an Arcane spell become Moonlit. Full rules in Aspect of Hope.

features.name: Solar Purge
features.bodyHtml: Channel the purifying heat of the sun to purge negative effects and conditions from a creature, including Charm, Fear, Fright, Sleep, Confusion, Petrification, Paralysis, Stun, Burn, Poison, Chill, Frozen, Shock, Bleeding, Blindness, Restraint, Polymorph, Daze, Disease or Curse.

features.name: Lunar Aegis
features.bodyHtml: Manifest a resilient lunar aura around an ally, increasing their Armour Class by 2.

features.name: Lunar Wisp

stats.label: Duration
stats.value: Until Long Rest or combat ends

features.bodyHtml:
Call a sliver of moonlight to follow your healing.

You gain Lunar Wisp. While it lasts, whenever you heal an ally, they also gain temporary hit points equal to your Arcana level plus twice your Wisdom modifier. You can't cast it again while it is active.

features.name: Starbreath
features.bodyHtml:
Channel a spark of stellar power into a fallen ally. They return to life with 10% of their maximum hit points.

At higher levels: 30% with a level 4 slot, 60% with a level 5 slot, 100% with a level 6 slot.

features.name: Lucent Singularity
features.bodyHtml:
Condense radiant light into a gravitational point that dispels magical darkness. The singularity's pull creates Difficult Terrain, while its brilliance encases enemies in Faerie Fire.

Enemies within 15m of the point are caught in Difficult Terrain and revealed by Faerie Fire, so Attack Rolls against them have Advantage.

features.name: Star Radiance
features.bodyHtml: Emit a brilliant aura of starlight that empowers you and nearby allies. Your weapon attacks and those of your allies within 9m deal an additional 1d4 Radiant damage.

features.name: Sunrise
features.bodyHtml: You can now reach Tier II of the Aspect of Hope by restoring hit points equal to 8 times your level in one fight. Moonlit deals 2d4 Cold instead, and allies you heal or target with an Arcane spell also become Sunlit. See Aspect of Hope.

features.name: Wish
features.bodyHtml:
Call upon the stars to heal yourself and nearby allies. Every ally within 18m regains 4d4 hit points. Undead and Constructs are not healed.

At higher levels: 5d4 with a level 5 slot, 6d4 with a level 6 slot.

features.name: Moon Gravity
features.bodyHtml:
Manipulate gravity to grant an ally total freedom of movement. Instantly remove Stun. The target is unaffected by Difficult Terrain and cannot be magically Paralysed or Restrained.

Their movement speed can't be reduced by spells or magical effects. Non-magical restraints can be escaped by spending 1.5m of movement.

features.name: Equinox
features.bodyHtml: Manifest a zone of celestial equilibrium. Enemies within the area are Silenced. When the field dissipates after 1 turn, any enemies still inside become Restrained for 1 turn.

features.name: Astral Fortitude
features.bodyHtml: Bolster your allies within 6m with celestial energy to increase their hit point maximum by an amount equal to your Arcana level. A Downed ally in the area also regains 1 hit point. You don't receive the bonus yourself.

features.name: Solar Flare
features.bodyHtml:
Call down a pillar of solar fire that may Stun and Burn enemies in the area.

Each creature in the area takes 8d6 Fire damage, is Stunned for 1 turn and Burning for 3 turns. On a successful save, it takes half damage and is Burning for 1 turn. The ground in the area ignites.

features.name: Final Spark
features.bodyHtml:
Release a concentrated beam of pure radiant energy. All creatures caught in its path take 6d6 Radiant damage and are Blinded and encased in Faerie Fire for 1 turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and suffers neither condition.

Until the spell ends (2 turns), you shed light around you and can cast Recast Final Spark: an action that costs no Woven Spell Slot and releases another beam with the same damage and conditions.

features.name: Aspect of Hope
features.bodyHtml: You can now reach Tier III by restoring hit points equal to 12 times your level in one fight. Your Wisdom increases by 3, Sunlit deals 2d4 Fire instead, allies you heal or target with an Arcane spell gain Eclipse, and the first ally who would be downed during the fight instead regains half their hit points. See Aspect of Hope.

features.name: Stellar Grace
features.bodyHtml: Bind your companions' fates to the enduring light of the cosmos. Your allies within 18m regain the maximum hit points possible when healed. They also gain Advantage on Wisdom Saving Throws and Death Saving Throws.

blocks.html:
From level 3, every fight can awaken the Star within you. What counts is the healing you give: each hit point you restore to an ally during combat adds to a running total for that fight. Healing yourself doesn't count, and neither does healing past an ally's maximum hit points. Your progress towards the next tier appears as the Awakening Progress status, shown in percent.

Each goal is a multiple of your level. When your total reaches a goal, that tier awakens and stays until combat ends. Tiers awaken in order and stack, and you can only reach the tiers your level has unlocked: Tier I at level 3, Tier II at level 7, Tier III at level 12. When combat ends, the total and every tier reset.

Once awakened, the Aspect turns your support into damage. Every ally you heal, and every ally you target with an Arcane spell, receives the marks of your current tier for 2 turns. Each mark empowers that ally's next attack that hits, then fades.

tiers.label: Tier I · Beacon
itemsHtml: Allies you heal or target become Moonlit: their next attack that hits deals an additional 1d4 Cold and reduces the target's movement speed by 3m for 1 turn.
You gain the spell Wish Upon a Star.

tiers.label: Tier II · Sunrise
itemsHtml: Allies also become Sunlit: their next attack that hits deals an additional 1d4 Fire and sets the target Burning for 2 turns.

tiers.label: Tier III · Aspect of Hope
itemsHtml: Allies also gain Eclipse: Resistant to Cold and Fire damage for 2 turns.
You and every ally in the fight gain Undying Hope: the first of you who would be downed instead regains half their hit points, and the protection ends for everyone.

feature.name: Wish Upon a Star
feature.bodyHtml: Available while the Aspect of Hope is awakened. Grant your allies within 18m Advantage on their next Attack Roll. The blessing lasts 2 turns or until they attack, and costs no Woven Spell Slot.

blocks.title: Awakening Faster
blocks.html:
• Big heals on badly hurt allies count in full; topping up someone who is nearly full wastes the excess.
  • Wish heals everyone within 18m at once, so one bonus action can cover a large share of a goal.
  • Arcane spells you cast on allies, such as Lunar Aegis or Moon Gravity, also apply your marks once the Aspect is awake, even when they heal nothing.
